ASSESSMENT OVERVIEW: The $40,000 sign-on bonus results in $24,800 net cash. The repayment rider requires repayment of 1/12th monthly ($2,067) for 12 months if voluntarily resigned within 12 months, totaling $24,800. Since repayment ends at Month 12, leaving at Month 18 incurs no obligation. All constraints are satisfied. Key facts: Sign-on bonus: $40,000 gross, $24,800 net; Repayment: 1/12th monthly ($2,067) for 12 months = $24,800 total, ending at Month 12; Voluntary resignation within 12 months triggers repayment; after Month 12, obligation is $0.
POINTS OF NOTE: No concrete constraint violations flagged.
SUGGESTED NEXT STEP: None required; stated constraints appear satisfied.
